verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is not itself an agent. It is a skills and plugin package for agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Pi, backed by the YYLO CLI and Ledger, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only skill and plugin installation via `npx skills` and `yy skills install`, plus CLI-driven Ledger commands. Nothing documents an MCP server, endpoint or `mcp serve` mode.
